test_title: PYST 33: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only four people sit between C and E when counted from the right of C. C sits third to the left of P. B sits third to the left of F. Q is an immediate neighbour of both E and P. How many people sit between A and Q when counted from the right of A?1854
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. C sits third to the left of P.

2. Q is an immediate neighbour of both E and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec449f05da777e14628c484bdb9141c5ee6bcf0dff753bcafa19f28ad8c58474.png] 

3. Only four people sit between C and E when counted from the right of C.

The above statement cannot be satisfied in case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c82d6af7e2e47e037021f967581f76c70a72002aaece70c1110573b4f79f232d.png] 

4. B sits third to the left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3b2d42c14d76c66a65a1d45023d6a8e0215afc52db7a08140d252651a4a97c1.png] 

A, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3ce41d128cc992f352398e6f8ea469938c1027c4a6feb3d2a97866adad37b5a.png] 

Thus, two people sit between A and Q when counted from the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
